conclusions.text: The six Atlas identities, source names, Census GEOIDs/state codes/LSADC values and retained county-level crosswalk joins are unique and reproducible in the pinned baseline.
Fresh 2026 TIGERweb comparison IoUs reproduce the archived #1162 values at eight decimal places; archived 2018 CBF IoUs remain unchanged and are not recomputed.
Whether any of the six compared geometries matches a legally authoritative, exhaustive county boundary—including coastal water, islands or offshore extent—remains unresolved.

methods.description: Strict unique-ID joins for the six declared Atlas, 2018 geoBoundaries, and 2026 Census features; native EPSG:4326 validity/component/vertex checks without repair; fresh EPSG:5070 intersection-over-union; full state-roster identity checks. Archived 2018 IoUs are preserved from the frozen crosswalk, not recomputed.
